title: Invariant constant-rank strata of a finite locally free affine groupoid
statement: Let $U=\operatorname{Spec}A$ and $R=\operatorname{Spec}B$ be affine schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $s,t:R\to U$, $e:U\to R$, $i:R\to R$, and $c:R\times_{s,U,t}R\to R$ [def-pc-fibre-product] define a groupoid: functorially in every test scheme $H$, they make $U(H)$ the objects and $R(H)$ the arrows, with source $s$, target $t$, identity $e$, inverse $i$, and composition $c$. Assume $s,t$ are finite locally free [def-pc-finite-locally-free]. There is a finite set $I\subset\mathbf Z_{\ge1}$ and a disjoint open-and-closed decomposition $U=\coprod_{r\in I}U_r$ into nonempty affine open subschemes such that $R_r=s^{-1}(U_r)=t^{-1}(U_r)$ is affine, all the structure maps restrict to a groupoid on $(U_r,R_r)$, and $s_r,t_r:R_r\to U_r$ are finite locally free of degree $r$. If $U$ is empty, $I$ is empty. Here degree $r$ means that every scheme-theoretic fibre has coordinate algebra of dimension $r$ over the residue field of its base point.

source.place: Tag 03BI (groupoids-lemma-finite-locally-free-disjoint-free), its affine quasi-compact specialization; the nonempty constant-rank pieces used in the proof of lemma-integral-over-invariants.

proof.text: Apply [lem-a1-affine-split-morphism-positive-rank-pieces] to $f=s$ and its section $e$. Obtain $d$, the clopen affine strata $U_r=d^{-1}(r)$, $U_0=\varnothing$, and the finite set $I=\{r\geq1:U_r\ne\varnothing\}$. Their inverse images $V_r=s^{-1}(U_r)$ are affine and $s_r:V_r\to U_r$ has degree $r$. The strata indexed by $I$ are nonempty, pairwise disjoint and cover $U$; if $U$ is empty, $I$ is empty.

source.place: Tag 03BI (groupoids-lemma-finite-locally-free-disjoint-free), positive-degree argument, and Tag 03BJ (groupoids-lemma-integral-over-invariants), first proof paragraph, abstracted to an affine finite locally free morphism admitting a section; rank strata: Morphisms Tag 04MH (morphisms-lemma-finite-locally-free); clopen affine pieces: Algebra Tags 00E8 (algebra-lemma-quasi-compact) and 00EE (algebra-lemma-disjoint-decomposition), Schemes Tag 01I3 (schemes-lemma-standard-open-affine).

proof.text: Apply [lem-a1-groupoid-source-pullback-translation] to the given groupoid and finite locally free $s$. Its rank consequence gives $d(t(z))=d(s(z))$ for every $z\in R$. Since $U_r=d^{-1}(r)$ from step 1, membership in $s^{-1}(U_r)$ is equivalent to membership in $t^{-1}(U_r)$. Thus $V_r=s^{-1}(U_r)=t^{-1}(U_r)$ as open subschemes.

source.place: Tag 03BI (groupoids-lemma-finite-locally-free-disjoint-free), comparison of the two source fibres using Tag 02YE.

proof.text: Apply [lem-a1-groupoid-invariant-open-restriction-degree] with $W=U_r$ and $V=V_r$ for each $r\in I$. The invariant-open equality proved in step 2 is its hypothesis. It gives all restricted groupoid structure maps, compatible with the inclusions, and transports the degree $r$ of $s_r$ from step 1 to $t_r$. Set $R_r=V_r$. Together with the finite affine clopen decomposition in step 1 these are every claimed clause.
